sample_1.prompt: A close-up of a woman's hand carefully pressing a sealed white envelope shut, a red neighborhood mailbox open in the background on a sunny suburban street. Soft golden afternoon light, a few autumn leaves on the ground. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, warm tones, cinematic close-up composition.

sample_2.prompt: A person sitting at an elegant dining table pulling a gold-embossed invitation card from a cream-colored envelope, eyes wide with delight. Candlelight flickers nearby, casting a warm glow on the luxurious card. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, rich amber and gold tones, cinematic intimate composition.

sample_3.prompt: A young man sitting alone at a kitchen table, hands trembling slightly as he tears open a plain white envelope, his face tight with nervous anticipation. A single overhead light illuminates the scene. The folded paper inside is just barely visible. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, cool-neutral tones, cinematic tense composition.
